name: unstorage
solves: Provides a unified async key-value storage API with dozens of drivers (memory, FS, Redis, Cloudflare, Netlify, Vercel KV, etc.), mounting, watching, and metadata — popular in the UnJS/Nitro/Nuxt ecosystem.
best_for: Nuxt/Nitro apps that want one storage API across local, Redis, and edge drivers
Projects that swap storage backends per environment without rewriting call sites
Edge-friendly key-value access with driver mounting and prefixes
Caching and persistence layers in UnJS tooling
Teams that want Keyv-like portability with a larger modern driver set
skip_when: You need advanced Redis-only features (streams, cluster-aware scripting) via a raw client
You only need a synchronous in-process LRU — lru-cache is lighter
You want a full HTTP response caching framework with stampede protection (cacheable)
Your stack has no UnJS affinity and Keyv already covers your backends
You require strict transactional semantics beyond simple KV

hosted_alternative.name: Upstash Redis
hosted_alternative.pricing_summary: Pay-per-request serverless Redis with a free tier; works as an unstorage driver target
